title: Where the keys live
subtitle: The thing that was missing before: a keyring on the device, what it is, what it is not, and the one rule about which key may travel. 8 panels.
rule: Every line a character says is the storyboard's, not a quote, and is marked not_a_quote; evidence panels quote this site's pages word for word, which the build checks.

scenes.title: Where the keys live
scenes.subtitle: A key that is written down somewhere is a key that is not lost.
scenes.note: The brief's diagnosis: with nowhere to keep a key, nobody made a vault.

scenes.caption: Last month's vault

cast.says: I made a vault last month. Where did I put the key?

scenes.note: There is no reset. A vault key that is lost is a vault that cannot be written to again.

scenes.caption: The keyring, on this device

cast.says: Every key this site makes, with its kind.

scenes.note: One JSON document in the browser's storage, a kind on every entry, exportable.

scenes.caption: Plaintext, on this device

cast.says: Give me the laptop and I have them.

scenes.note: The keyring makes keys findable; it does not protect them from someone with the device.

scenes.caption: Export, to somewhere stronger
scenes.note: Where each kind of key should live, today and later.

scenes.caption: The rule

lines: vault key: never. Not in a link,
a page, a chat, a repository

scenes.note: The one rule about which key may travel.

scenes.caption: No reset

evidence.quote: There is no reset. A vault whose vault key is lost cannot be written to again
